question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is - "**was featured".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 2** requires the correct usage of Tense.
 
• As the opening sentence of the paragraph tells us that the passage is in a simple past test with the usage of **'was'.**
 
• Following the rule of Parallelism in the tense usage, we will use **simple past tense in blank 2 **__of this question.
 
• **Structure of Simple past tense**: Subject(He/She/It/You/We/They) + **Past form of the verb(V2).**
 
• With the above-given explanation, we can tell that **option 3** is the correct answer.

The complete passage is- *Nawab Mir Osman Ali Khan was the last ruler of Hyderabad, the largest princely state in British India. He ascended the throne **(1) at** the age of 25 and ruled Hyderabad for 37 years. He** (2) was featured** on the cover of Time magazine as the **(3) richest** person at the time. He was the 5th richest man in **(4) the**** history of mankind and the richest Indian who ever lived. He was a (5)benevolent ruler who encouraged education, science and development.*
